ns2:course.label: Intro Quantum Electr for EEs
ns2:course.description: Application of quantum mechanical concepts to electronics problems; detailed analysis of a calculable two-state laser system; incidental quantum ideas bearing on electronics. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PHYS 485.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PHYS 485.
